description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取港股公司最新股东数据。可按股票代码进行筛选，返回最近报告期的股东构成。当用户需要了解某港股公司的最新股东结构、主要股东持股变化或捕捉股东异动信号时，调用此接口。
description.en: Fetch latest shareholder data for Hong Kong companies, returning the most recent reporting period's shareholder composition. Used when understanding recent shareholder structure, tracking major shareholder position changes, or identifying shareholder activity signals.
